summary: Sacnoth/Nautilus's occult alternate-history JRPG lineage, beginning with the PlayStation predecessor Koudelka and continuing through the three PlayStation 2 Shadow Hearts games.

entries.title: Koudelka

emulation.notes: Use PGXP and internal-resolution scaling while preserving the original aspect ratio.

primary.why: Koudelka is a PlayStation-only horror RPG and the predecessor set in the same world as Shadow Hearts; DuckStation gives the highest-fidelity capture route for the complete original game.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PlayStation disc image in DuckStation with PGXP, internal-resolution scaling, and the original aspect ratio.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official port or remaster is documented.

entries.title: Shadow Hearts

primary.why: The first Shadow Hearts is a PS2-only sequel to Koudelka with no documented port or remaster, so PCSX2 is the highest-fidelity complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PS2 disc image in PCSX2 with high internal resolution and deinterlacing. Keep the original aspect ratio unless a widescreen patch is verified safe.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official port or remaster is documented.

entries.title: Shadow Hearts: Covenant

emulation.notes: Use internal-resolution scaling and deinterlacing; choose the English release only as an accessibility fallback.

primary.why: Covenant's Japan-exclusive Director's Cut has additional content, making it the most complete version; PCSX2 supplies the highest-fidelity route. The international PS2 release is the practical English fallback but not the most complete build.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped Japanese Director's Cut PS2 disc image in PCSX2 with high internal resolution and deinterlacing. If Japanese text is a blocker, play the North American or PAL PS2 release via PCSX2 and accept the missing Director's Cut additions.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official HD remaster is documented.

entries.title: Shadow Hearts: From the New World

primary.why: From the New World is a PS2-only continuation/spin-off with no documented port or remaster, so PCSX2 is the highest-fidelity complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PS2 disc image in PCSX2 with high internal resolution and deinterlacing. Preserve the original presentation unless a widescreen fix is verified safe.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official port or remaster is documented.
